As a result `_send_weekly_digest` at server.py:10496 computes `preview_url = ''` (fallback REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is a frontend-only env var, not present in the Python process), `is_preview_env=False`, and the digest never logs 'Skipping send — running in PREVIEW environment'. Setting `health_weekly_send_from_preview=true` therefore has no observable effect (both runs already attempt send and only fail because SMTP isn't configured).

rca of the issue: 0.2 RCA: In /app/backend/server.py line 10504, `preview_url = os.environ.get('preview_endpoint', '') or os.environ.get('REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL', '')`. The first key isn't in backend/.env. The second key is a CRA convention — only injected into the frontend webpack build, never into the Python process — so `os.environ.get('REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL')` returns None. Hence `preview_url=''`, `is_preview_env = '.preview.' in '' = False`, and the early-return at line 10510 never executes. Reproduction: PUT /api/admin/settings with `{health_weekly_enabled:true, health_weekly_send_from_preview:false}`, then POST /api/admin/health/run-weekly-now → backend log shows `SMTP not configured` (i.e., it tried to send) and no 'Skipping send — running in PREVIEW environment' log line. Mitigation: add `preview_endpoint` to backend/.env OR amend the helper to include `os.environ.get('PUBLIC_BASE_URL', '')` (already populated).
